title: Keyboard remapper doesn't work in Windows 11 emoji picker
author: SeeringPhil

status.label: Owned by upstream maintainer
status.detail: The issue is open, reproducible, Priority-2, and assigned to crutkas. The latest discussion says similar emoji-picker focus behavior occurs with PowerToys closed and changes with NumLock; no linked PR exists.

next_action: Leave the investigation with the assigned maintainer; re-evaluate if ownership is released or new evidence requests help.

judgment.rationale: This open Priority-2 issue is explicitly assigned to crutkas, so it already has an upstream owner and should not receive competing triage work. The recent commenter also reports that related emoji-picker focus behavior occurs with PowerToys closed and changes when NumLock is toggled, but no linked PR or resolution is recorded.
evidence: The issue is labeled Status-Reproducible and Priority-2, remains open, and is currently assigned to crutkas.
The original report says remapped keys do not navigate the Windows 11 emoji picker until focus changes, and similar behavior was observed with the UAC prompt.
A January 2026 commenter reports the emoji-picker behavior also occurs with PowerToys closed and that toggling NumLock can change it, suggesting Windows focus/input behavior may contribute.
No closing pull request or other covering fix is linked.
judgment.recommended_action: Do not start a parallel fix while the assigned upstream maintainer owns the open investigation; re-evaluate only if ownership changes or the maintainer requests help.

fix_assessment.rationale: The issue already has an active upstream maintainer owner. No competing code change should be proposed by this triage artifact; the issue remains open and owned, not resolved.

issue_context.summary: Keyboard remaps may not navigate the Windows 11 emoji picker until its focus state changes; a later report says similar behavior occurs even with PowerToys closed and can change with NumLock.
known_information: The issue is open, marked Status-Reproducible and Priority-2, and assigned to crutkas.
The original report compares Windows 10 and Windows 11 emoji picker behavior and says remapped arrows are initially ignored.
Later comments discuss the Windows emoji picker focus state and a NumLock-dependent behavior that also occurs with PowerToys closed.
No linked PR or resolved status is present.
inferences: Some observed behavior may belong to the Windows emoji picker rather than Keyboard Manager, but this does not prove that all remap failures in the original report are external.
The active assignment is evidence of ownership, not evidence that the defect is fixed.
issue_context.analysis: The issue has current maintainer ownership and a focused app-compat investigation, so a separate proposal would duplicate effort. Preserve the owner and the evidence that Windows behavior may contribute without claiming the open issue is resolved.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue body and all 12 comments, including the recent PowerToys-closed and NumLock observations.
Confirmed crutkas is the current assignee and the issue remains open with Priority-2 and Status-Reproducible labels.
Checked the issue's closed-by-PR references; none is linked.
